---
title: "Differential Expression"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source("R/read_manifest.R")
source("R/read_summary.R")
source("R/tables.R")
source("R/plot_helpers.R")

result_dir <- get_result_dir("data")
manifest <- read_manifest(result_dir)
deg_summary <- read_summary_for_step(result_dir, manifest, "deg")
```

## DEG Summary

```{r deg-status, results='asis'}
if (is.null(deg_summary)) {
  cat("DEG summary not available. Differential expression outputs are expected under figure/deg/ when this step is run.")
} else {
  cat(paste0("Status: **", deg_summary$status, "**  "))
  cat(paste0("Result files: ", deg_summary$metrics$result_file_count %||% 0))
}
```

## DEG Plots

```{r deg-plots, fig.cap="Differential expression plots", out.width="48%"}
if (!is.null(deg_summary)) display_images(result_dir, deg_summary, max_images = 12)
```

## Top DEG Results

```{r deg-table}
deg_artifacts <- artifact_table(deg_summary, types = "csv")
deg_csv <- artifact_abs_paths(result_dir, deg_artifacts)[1]
if (!is.na(deg_csv) && file.exists(deg_csv)) {
  top_deg <- read.csv(deg_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  knitr::kable(head(top_deg, 30), format = "html")
} else {
  cat("No DEG CSV files found.")
}
```

## DEG Files

```{r deg-files}
if (nrow(deg_artifacts) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(deg_artifacts[, intersect(c("type", "path", "bytes"), colnames(deg_artifacts)), drop = FALSE], format = "html")
} else {
  cat("No DEG artifacts recorded.")
}
```
